write_up: Your resume points toward Accounts Payable Specialist work: you process vendor invoices at Bayou Industrial Supply, after bookkeeping in Houston and senior accounting in Vietnam. A recruiter can see both the current workload and the broader accounting experience, so I'd expect this resume to move forward with a few questions.

The strongest line is the month-end close improvement at Minh Phat Trading Company. It gives the starting and ending times and names the checklist and template you made. Your current invoice line also gives a recruiter a useful picture of your work with QuickBooks and purchase orders.

Let's start with your month-end work at Bayou: name what you helped the controller do. Then add your part in the external audit at Minh Phat. A final grammar pass will help the accounting work come through cleanly.
